outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of whole lungs; it is a photograph, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD, and the individual data points for each mouse (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C combines micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) with spatial expression heatmaps (Cd68, Spp1). Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values from differential gene expression analysis (low pH vs high pH spatial transcriptomics spots), not a mean computed across a small number of discrete biological replicates. Each bar represents a single computed statistic per gene (with its own Wilcoxon test p value) rather than an average of individually plottable replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrographs/photographs of lung sections; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
